title: Merging Embedded Topics with Optimal Transport for Online Topic Modeling on Data Streams
venue: Machine Learning and Knowledge Discovery in Databases (ECML PKDD 2025), LNCS
subcategory: online topic modelling with optimal transport
task: Topic modelling on text streams with change-point detection
problem: Online topic models either cannot store streams (online LDA) or do not truly merge topic representations across batches (MergeBERT).
architecture: StreamETM: an ETM is trained per batch with topic embeddings initialised from the previous step; topics of consecutive models are merged with unbalanced optimal transport (cosine cost, KL marginal relaxation), new topics are added when unmatched; online change-point detection on topic proportions.

datasets.name: 20kNewsGroup
datasets.details: 5 of 20 topics; 15 draws of about 5k documents split into 500-document batches (about 10 time steps), Custom and Dynamic settings

key_results: UOT with cosine cost: merging accuracy 0.79, discovery accuracy 0.93 (harmonic mean 0.85) vs cosine-distance matching 0.84 / 0.72 (0.77).
Custom setting t0-t3: StreamETM TC 0.59-0.65 vs MergeBERT 0.43-0.52 and OnlineBERT 0.41-0.45.
strengths: Actually merges topic representations over time and flags change points for analysts.

limitations.text: Vocabulary is fixed (no extension over time) and the number of topics is not selected on the fly.
Evaluation uses re-sampled 20 Newsgroups subsets (the same document may appear in several datasets) rather than a real stream.
